chunks: With this chain of transmission: Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام had the schoolchildren place their tablets before him so that he might choose among them, then he said:

Indeed, this is a judgment, and injustice in it is like injustice in judicial ruling. Inform your teacher that if he strikes you with more than three blows in discipline, retaliation shall be taken from him.

key_terms.حُكُومَةٌ: a matter of judgment or adjudication

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a teacher striking children for discipline?
ai.summary: This hadith presents the evaluation and disciplining of children as a matter of judgment in which justice must be observed. It states that excessive corporal discipline is a form of wrongdoing and establishes liability for a teacher who exceeds the limit.
